thread:
Leah (PM): Heads-up: Big customer is asking for tenant-level routing + SSO for their pilot. They want ~10 tenants in pilot and basic audit export. Go/no-go date 2026-07-20.

Omar (Sales): Yep, conditional commitment on that date. They need a pilot SLA and logs they can attach to their security review.

Diego (Eng): Rough take: routing changes (namespacing + cache) ~3w, OIDC SSO ~2w, infra config + canary ~2w, QA 1w. Minimal optimistic ~8w.

Nina (Design): For pilot I can deliver a single read-only tenant admin page + CSV export in one sprint; full admin UX is v1.

Sam (TPM): Options: A) Pull tenant+SSO into current MVP (delay other planned items) B) Build a narrow pilot feature-flagged and keep MVP timeline C) Ask customer for later pilot date.

Lina (QA): QA can cover a tight pilot if we limit to one IdP provider; full IdP matrix requires more time.

Omar (Sales): Customer is ok with "pilot" labeling and reduced guarantees if we give early access pricing. Legal will want a pilot SOW.

Leah (PM): Quick must/ defer cutlist for pilot:
Must: tenant-scoped routing, OIDC SSO (single IdP), request-level CSV audit export, canary infra for 10 tenants.
Defer: tenant role mgmt UI, multi-IdP orchestration, billing reconciliation.

Diego (Eng): Implementation plan: feature-flag routing namespace, OIDC first, reuse tracer for log export. I'll draft RFC.

Sam (TPM): Vote: react :one: = Option A, :two: = Option B, :three: = Option C. Please react now.

(20s pause)

Leah (PM): Tally: 0 for A, 5 for B, 1 for C. Narrow pilot (B) wins.

Leah (PM): Action items: Omar - draft pilot SOW and soft commitment (due EOD). Diego - RFC + feature-flag PR (3 business days). Lina - QA plan scoped to 1 IdP (5 business days). Nina - pilot mock + CSV copy (4 business days). Sam - update milestone tracker and ETA.

ci-bot: Note: protected-branches require 2 approvals before merge.

Leah (PM): We'll sync tomorrow 09:30 to confirm PR links and any scope changes. Thanks. :raised_hands:
